_comment: Sensitivity ranges for the parametric simulator. Values bracket typical passenger cars and consumer/telematics sensors; they are NOT fitted to LiRA-CD labels. Sources: [G] T.D. Gillespie, Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics, SAE, 1992 (ride frequencies ~1-1.5 Hz, wheel hop ~10-12 Hz, damping ratio 0.2-0.4, rear/front frequency ratio > 1 for flat ride); [S] M.W. Sayers et al., World Bank TP 45/46, 1986 (Golden-Car reference: body 1.27 Hz, zeta 0.38, mu 0.15); [Z] manufacturer data for the LiRA-CD vehicle (Renault Zoe: kerb mass ~1.5 t, wheelbase 2.588 m), used only to check that the ranges contain it; [M] measured in LiRA-CD car files by this project (AutoPi rates 56-260 Hz, 0.01 g resolution, mounting tilt up to ~11 deg, |g| scale 1.003-1.014); [D] MEMS accelerometer data-sheet noise densities (typ. 100-400 ug/sqrt(Hz), e.g. Bosch BMI160 ~180, InvenSense MPU-6050 ~400).

x_s.src: sensor between CG and front axle (LiRA readme: near front axle)

synthetic._iso_ref: ISO 8608:2016 classes A-E geometric means 16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096 x 1e-6 m^3

sensor_phone.src: D (smartphone IMUs); cradle resonance range is an assumption, treated as sensitivity
